title: Rewrite action-item tables with new columns (Task ID, Legacy ID, Blocked by, Tier)
objective: Restructure each phase's action-item table in recovery_plan_latex_contract.md so Plan-2-Tasks reads canonical task IDs, dependency edges, and test tiers directly off the table — eliminating implicit decomposition guesswork.

plan_assets.asset_description: New action-item table header pattern with seven columns including Task ID, Legacy ID, Blocked by, Tier
Tier vocabulary (unit | integration | regression | docs | manual) with example assignments per phase

scope: Rewrite every phase's action-item table in dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md
Convert legacy 'R0.1' style IDs to canonical 'P<phase>-<seq>' while keeping the legacy ID in a Legacy ID column
Fill Blocked by with canonical IDs (using '—' for none) and Tier from {unit, integration, regression, docs, manual}
implementation_steps: For each phase 1..7, locate the existing action-item table
Add columns: Task ID | Legacy ID | Action item | Files / surfaces | Blocked by | Tier | Verification
Number tasks sequentially within phase as P<N>-1, P<N>-2, ...
Copy legacy IDs (R0.1, R0.2, ...) into the Legacy ID column unchanged
Fill Tier using hint set: docs for R0 rows; integration/regression for R1.5/R1.6, R2.1, R2.5, R3.1, R3.4, R5.1, R5.3, R6.1, R6.2; unit elsewhere
Fill Blocked by with canonical IDs only — cross-phase blockers use the canonical ID format
deliverables: Seven rewritten action-item tables in dev/plans/recovery_plan_latex_contract.md
Every row has Task ID, Legacy ID, Blocked by, and Tier populated
Tier values drawn only from the documented vocabulary
acceptance_criteria: Every action-item table contains the seven-column header from amendment 3
Every row has a non-empty Task ID matching the regex P[1-7]-[0-9]+
No row has an empty Tier; only documented vocabulary values appear
Cross-phase blockers reference canonical IDs (e.g. P2-1) and not legacy IDs (e.g. R1.1)

cases: Each table has seven columns with the agreed names
Task ID values are unique within phase and increasing
Legacy ID column preserves the original R-style IDs
Tier vocabulary is restricted to the five permitted values

risks: Manual rewrite risks dropping rows or breaking row-to-prose ordering — mitigated by reviewing table row count against the prose action-item enumeration immediately after each phase rewrite
completion_notes: Rewrote 7 action-item tables with seven columns (Task ID | Legacy ID | Action item | Files / surfaces | Blocked by | Tier | Verification); 32 canonical Task IDs assigned; cross-phase blockers reference canonical IDs only; test_p1_3 passes 4/4.
